title: Huddle: Know Who’s Free, Right Now (Pitch)

s1.description: Problem and user: friends can’t see who is free right now.

s2.description: Solution: a widget and app with free times, statuses, tags and pings.

s3.description: v1 versus later: the smallest version that proves the habit.

s4.description: Success metric: spontaneous hangouts per user per week.

s5.description: Wrap and Q&A: recap, the pilot ask and likely questions.
